notes.title: Carving Contest Winners
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who participated in the Pumpkin SculptrVR Carving Contest!

Seeing new entries show up every day made October my favorite month of the year. (Seriously)

In the end we couldn't limit ourselves to just 5 winners, so we added a second prize pool! 5 winners get a $100 Steam Wallet, and 7 others get a $20 Steam Wallet.

Those of you who won a prize, please DM @Sculptrvr on twitter to receive your Steam Wallet key!

Without further ado, here are the 
5 grand prize winners:

“Jack Skellington” by @Dogs__101
